race.comment: SECOND DRAFT (10) was all set to make his debut but had to be late-scratched after pulling a plate before the start. He hails from the powerful Williams stable, and with William Pike taking the ride, he should make an immediate impact. GUNNING FOR GOLD (7) made a solid impression on debut at Northam when finishing third on a heavy track there nearly 2 weeks ago, and he will naturally improve with the run. He carries 1.5kg less this time and can get the job done. CALL ME INVINCIBLE (1) ran on late to finish fourth here last time out, and he will have a big swing in his draw this time. Each way all day. UNANSWERED (6) only battled late on a heavy track at Northam last time out, and his third prior on a firmer surface at Pinjarra-Scarpside is the guide to use. Stick with him. WESTERN PHOENIX (12) makes his debut after winning a trial late last month. He looks to be very talented, and if not too green, he can figure in the top 3. Check the markets.
